primarySource.finding: Big ARG common-ancestor rate choose(k,2), recombination rate k*rho, and finite-time one-lineage claim; a=1 and b=rho reproduce these count rates. Spatial lineage and breakpoint choices are outside this module.

findings: totalRate is b*k+a*k*(k-1)/2 and is proved positive for k>=2, a>0, b>=0. Frozen normalizedRatio=2*b/a and literal_up_kernel_mass/literal_down_kernel_mass identify the jump probabilities used by pathLaw.

jointLaw is the product of the actual frozen count-path law and infinite independent unit-exponential innovations. The source proves both path marginals, independence between full count and clock paths, and independence among clock coordinates.

holdingLaw is the measurable fixed-count-path pushforward under stopped rate scaling. holdingLaw_survival_cylinder gives the finite conditional survival product for every positive hitting count path and pre-hit finite cylinder; joint_holding_observation identifies its exact integration against the count-path law for measurable count and waiting-path events.

firstHit is measurable and totalized to zero off the hitting event; physicalAbsorptionTime is separately measurable and equals infinity off that event. On hitting paths it is exactly the finite pre-hit ENNReal wait sum.

The frozen ae_finite_jump_absorption supplies hitting almost surely. For all n>=1, the worker derives pre-hit counts>=2, strictly positive waits, strictly increasing event times, finite physical time, and equality with the real first-hit event-time sum. Initial n=1 has firstHit=0 and time=0 almost surely; n>=2 has strictly positive finite time almost surely.

The rate-three count-two check and two-thirds upward jump mass are explicit endpoints. Common positive rescaling of a and b leaves normalizedRatio unchanged and divides raw waits by the scale by direct algebra; this is not a separate selected Lean endpoint. The b=0 case is included in the theorem quantifiers. Identical clock coordinates would fail the proved independent finite-cylinder law. There is no deterministic upper time bound or finite-time assertion on nonhitting paths.
